title: Heliosphere
desc: Live solar wind and geomagnetic data, translated into sound. The sun, audible.

title: Linger
desc: Short fiction and poetry at the speed of reflection. No scrolling, no skimming — just the prose.

title: Grainfield
desc: A browser-based granular synthesis explorer. Pull a sound apart on a node canvas and listen to its grains.

title: Chord Loom
desc: Build a chord and load it onto one of twelve breathing pads, each with its own envelope, tape-loop memory, and reverb.

title: Cadastre
desc: Generate a whole city from a seed — terrain, streets, parcels, parks, every place named. Pan, zoom, export it poster-size.

title: Earshot
desc: Four live field mics, thousands of kilometres apart, streaming right now. Nothing is pre-recorded — every layer comes from whatever happens to coincide.

title: Weather Reports
desc: Forty-six writers, one premise: an unexplained weather phenomenon over World C6H-ɛ. Read it as anthology, archive, or apply for a researcher post.

title: Single Cell Battle
desc: A turn-based microorganism battler ported from a Python sim. Roll a roster, fight the computer's, win and evolve — lose three times and die.

title: Moira
desc: A base curve swept through hundreds of rotations until it interferes with itself. Nine variations on an old moiré sketch, with inks that actually mix.

title: Jems
desc: Random points, Delaunay-triangulated into a mosaic of tonal glass. Regenerate for a new arrangement, export as SVG or PNG.

title: Lampo
desc: Twelve random points in four dimensions, resolved into a Bezier surface of revolution. Tune it, orbit it, keep the good ones.

title: Lateral Walks
desc: A trained lateral thinker looks through live webcams and follows the chain of ideas wherever it goes.

title: Streetwander
desc: An agent takes creative walks through real neighborhoods — notices briefly, thinks a lot. Each walk leaves a main artifact and a few companions.

title: Curiothymia
desc: A mind that wanders. Threads of thought, branching by association. Let your attention follow.

title: Dual-Emergence
desc: Two opposed agents negotiate every stage of a planet's life, formation to deep future. Eight worlds; some plateau, some endure.

title: Musical Morphospace
desc: A curiosity-driven agent exploring the space of possible musical grammars — the musics humanity didn't happen to invent.

title: Akros
desc: A complete constructed language built from scratch by autonomous AI agents. 735 words, 99 grammar patterns, a 7-god pantheon.

title: Marmalade
desc: An autonomous generative collage engine making art in the wild, on its own schedule.

title: Stimviz
desc: 138 digital archives spanning illustration, design, audio, architecture, typography, science, photography, and film.

title: Terragod
desc: Roll a continent, an island, an atoll, or a whole world. Pan, zoom, export as SVG or PNG.

title: Gazetteer
desc: Invent place names from a phoneme grammar. Seed one by integer, coordinate, or landmark, and watch it break apart.

title: Trungle Bunch
desc: A generative instrument grown, not laid out. Triangular bodies on a mycelial network, voiced by the colours their threads join.

title: Petri
desc: Two views of the same organism. One tab lets a colony crawl, eat, and grow under a cursor's pull; the other pins a single specimen to a slide — cell wall, nucleus, and reach rendered entirely in dots and lines.

title: Magpie
desc: Five magpies out looking for interesting things, each hunting a different way — by theme, by era, by obscurity, by memory. What they carry home gets transformed and woven into the collage.

title: Seismic Entropy
desc: True random numbers pulled from live seismic sensor noise at nine stations worldwide — a wall of raw integers, each traceable to real ground motion happening right now.

title: SFRC-RADIO
desc: An unattended internet radio station curated by an agent reading live planetary data — geomagnetic activity, solar wind, weather, aircraft overhead, the sun's position — and letting the sky decide what plays next.

title: Pangaea Otherwise
desc: A speculative plate-tectonics generator. It starts from the real Pangaea at 250 million years ago, lets you change how the supercontinent breaks apart and how the pieces drift, then plays out alternate Earths, and runs the clock on into the future.
